blockingFindings.title: Provider/profile cache-miss coverage is confounded by commandId changes
blockingFindings.issue: The R3 test claims to cover changed provider/profile identity, but the calls that change provider/profile also change commandId. An implementation that keys only on commandId and ignores provider/profileKey would still pass those assertions.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add or adjust a spec-local R3 assertion that changes provider and/or profileKey while keeping commandId and the rest of the prompt identity constant, and verifies a provider invocation occurs.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R3 explicitly requires provider and profileKey changes to be cache misses, and the current executable test can pass without exercising that production behavior.
